pins.name: R_EN
pins.notes: HIGH to enable. Often tied to L_EN

pins.name: R_IS
pins.notes: Current sense. Can exceed 3.3 V on a fault: add a divider before an ADC pin

pins.name: L_IS
pins.notes: Current sense. Can exceed 3.3 V on a fault: add a divider before an ADC pin

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: 5 V logic supply: use VIN. Inputs via a 74HC244 buffer: 3.3 V is below spec, often works

sources.title: Infineon BTS7960 datasheet
sources.section: Supply 5.5 to 27.5 V; IS current sense output
